Contact Us

We'd love to hear from you! Whether you're ordering a custom cake, asking about allergens, or just want to say hello, reach out using the form below, or stop by our shop in Millbrook.

Send Us a Message

Fill out the form and our team will get back to you within one business day.

Opening Hours

Fresh bread and pastries come out of the oven every morning. Here's when you can find us open.
